name: ProfileCard-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Whole card is visible with a blue-to-violet sheen across the portrait and the footer bar readable.

tagline: Portrait card tilts and slides a holographic sheen under the cursor.
summary: A tall portrait card with a tinted headshot, a large name and a glassy footer bar holding a handle, status and contact button. Moving the pointer tilts it and drags a colourful glare across the surface.
appearance: A tall portrait card with rounded corners holding a colour-tinted headshot that fills it. A big white-to-violet name sits over the photo with a faint job title beneath, and a translucent bar across the bottom holds a round avatar, handle, status and an outlined button. A blue-purple gradient covers the surface.
behaviour: Moving the pointer across the card tilts it in 3D and carries a glossy glare and rainbow sheen along with it; on leave it eases back flat. A short settle animation plays as it mounts, and a slow sheen loop runs continuously.
demo_content: Name Daniel Okafor, title Design Engineer, handle @danokafor, status Online, and the button reads Contact Me.
search_phrases: portrait card that follows the mouse
team member card with contact button
profile photo card with gradient sheen
user card with handle and online status
use_when: You want a memorable team or profile card whose tilt and sheen invite the pointer on a landing page.
avoid_when: Tilt needs a pointing device, so touch gets a flat card, and a missing avatar leaves only the gradient shell.
customise: Pass the name, title, handle, status, contact text and avatar images as props; tilt, mobile tilt, the behind glow and inner gradient are toggles. Colours, radius and layout are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One card and one pointer-tracking RAF loop that stops when settled, plus a slow CSS sheen keyframe.

a11y.note: The 3D tilt and sheen loop ignore reduced-motion, and the job title is drawn over the portrait where it is hard to read.

issues: The job title overlaps the name and portrait, so it is barely legible.
The shine and glare layers animate in a continuous loop, so the card never fully rests.
polish_why: Convincing holographic glare and tilt, but the job title collides with the name and photo.
